package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type OnboardingClock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

type PutStudentOnboardingInput struct {
	StudentID              string
	ExpectedVersion        int64
	DirectionCode          string
	SelfAssessedExperience string
	KnownStacks            []string
	DesiredStacks          []string
	GoalCode               string
	GoalText               string
	PreferredLanguage      string
	WeeklyMinutes          int
	PreferredPace          string
}

type PutStudentOnboarding struct {
	Profiles repository.StudentOnboardingRepository
	Clock    OnboardingClock
}

func (useCase PutStudentOnboarding) Handle(ctx context.Context, input PutStudentOnboardingInput) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if useCase.Profiles == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || input.ExpectedVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	createdAt := now
	version := int64(1)
	stored, err := useCase.Profiles.Get(ctx, input.StudentID)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		if input.ExpectedVersion != 0 {
			return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
	case err != nil:
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, err
	default:
		if input.ExpectedVersion != stored.Version {
			return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		createdAt = stored.CreatedAt.UTC()
		version = stored.Version + 1
	}

	profile, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboarding(domain.StudentOnboarding{
		StudentID: input.StudentID, DirectionCode: input.DirectionCode,
		SelfAssessedExperience: input.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks:            append([]string(nil), input.KnownStacks...),
		DesiredStacks:          append([]string(nil), input.DesiredStacks...),
		GoalCode:               input.GoalCode, GoalText: input.GoalText,
		PreferredLanguage: input.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: input.WeeklyMinutes,
		PreferredPace: input.PreferredPace, ProfileVersion: domain.StudentOnboardingProfileVersion,
		Version: version, CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Profiles.Save(ctx, profile, input.ExpectedVersion)
}

type GetStudentOnboarding struct {
	Profiles repository.StudentOnboardingRepository
}

func (useCase GetStudentOnboarding) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Profiles == nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, errors.New("student onboarding repository is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	profile, err := useCase.Profiles.Get(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, err
	}
	profile, err = domain.NormalizeStudentOnboarding(profile)
	if err != nil || profile.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.StudentOnboarding{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return profile, nil
}
